---
# Positive control for the handout imposition. A landscape poster asked for on
# letter paper must come back as ONE landscape letter page, not portrait and
# not two pages.
#
# Both halves have failed in development. The sheet is stored portrait, so
# without the orientation flip a 48x36 poster centres on 8.5x11 and throws
# away 40% of the paper. And the scaled poster is a page-height block on a
# smaller page: laid out in the flow rather than placed, Typst breaks it and
# the handout arrives as three pages of slices.
title: "Handout fixture"
format:
  sciposter-typst:
    poster:
      size: "48x36"
      columns: 2
      handout: letter
---
